subject: Implementation credit split playbook for residency + HSM / auditlog
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@mednovahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security add-ons + implementation credits (residency + HSM)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked great. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few clarifying questions before we loop in Legal:

- We need an implementation credit that offsets the on-prem residency work — can you summarize how Redwood typically splits implementation vs recurring credits for Residency + HSM?
- For HSM: is pricing per-seat (admin seat) or per-HSM-host? We have a mix of cloud HSMs and an on-prem FIPS HSM for PHI workflows.
- Audit log retention: what are the tiers and any additional ingest costs?
- HIPAA: are there typical SOW line items you amortize or treat as one-time?

I attached our security questionnaire to show the asks. Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Sr. Procurement Manager
MedNova Health

Attachment: MedNova_Security_RQ.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@mednovahealth.com>
Cc: Chris Patel <chris.patel@mednovahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security add-ons + implementation credits (residency + HSM)

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this through and for the time on Friday. I reviewed the questionnaire at a high level; happy to map answers and a commercial suggestion below.

High level commercial playbook we recommend: "Implementation credit split playbook"
- Residency (on‑prem / VPC): we typically amortize the onboarding and network integration work as an implementation credit applied against the first 12 months of committed Dedicated or Private spend. For examples, we’ll offer a $75k implementation credit spread over the first 12 monthly invoices against a $250k/year commit.
- HSM: two models — per-seat (admin console & key escrow) for small teams, or per-HSM-host for customers with dedicated hardware and strict separation. For MedNova's setup (one FIPS on-prem + cloud HSMs) we recommend per-HSM-host pricing with a smaller admin seat add-on. Example: $25k per HSM host/year + $5k admin-seat/year.
- Audit logs: retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 / custom). Ingest is metered; we include 30 days free for audit logs, then tiered pricing per GB. Long-retention (>365) typically carries a fixed monthly storage surcharge; we can convert to a predictable monthly per-seat fee if preferred.
- HIPAA SOW: large PHI-related integration work is usually split: one-time implementation effort (SOW) covered by implementation credit + ongoing monitoring/assurance as a recurring add-on.

Attached is a short playbook doc (I can send a cleaner PDF) and a sample SOW/amortization sketch. If this commercial approach looks OK, I’ll loop in Ben and Tessa to build a pricing worksheet and an explicit credit schedule tailored to your expected commit.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Thurs 12/2 to align on commit size and preferred credit amortization.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-residency-sow-draft.docx (docx, 56KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:51:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pricing sketch for MedNova — credit math

Karthik / Tessa — forwarding Sarah's note and my quick thoughts. Key considerations for the worksheet:

- Commit banding: we should show 3 bands (Pilot: $75–150k/yr, Scale: $250–500k/yr, Enterprise: 500k+). Implementation credit should scale non-linearly (higher relative credit at pilot to close deal).
- HSM amortization: for the on-prem FIPS HSM we can offer a $30k one-time implementation credit if they commit to 12 months at Scale band; that would be spread as $2.5k/mo credit. For cloud HSMs, treat as $15k one-time per provider if used.
- Audit log: convert to a flat per-seat retention add-on option for predictability (e.g., $3/user/month for 90-day retention) vs raw GB metering. Many procurement teams prefer the flat monthly to avoid surprises.
- Risk: Legal may push on indemnity — tie larger credits to a signed MSA + 60-day payment terms.

I'll draft a worksheet with three example tables and two optional credit flavors (amortized vs upfront rebate). Tessa — can you run this against our current pricing playbook and confirm the list prices we should show?

-Ben
VP, Commercial

Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing sketch for MedNova — credit math

Quick notes from pricing ops:

- Example worksheet: Pilot ($100k commit) -> Implementation credit $40k (spread over 12 months as $3.33k/mo). Scale ($300k) -> credit $90k (spread 12 months). Enterprise ($700k) -> credit $200k (spread 12 months). These numbers assume a 12-month amortization; if client prefers 6 months we can front-load the discount.
- HSM seat vs host: recommend we present both line items on the proposal: HSM-host: $28k/host/yr; HSM-admin-seat: $6k/seat/yr. Call out that on-prem FIPS will require a short implementation SOW for network routing and key ceremony. SOW estimate: 10–15 days at our standard rate; we'll convert to credit per the playbook.
- Audit logs: propose two SKU options: Predictable SKU ($3/user/mo for 90d) and Metered SKU ($0.08/GB after 30d included).
- HIPAA SOW: explicitly list deliverables and milestone credit triggers (MSA signed, SOC2 proof, network test complete).

I drafted a table and sample wording for the proposal. Karthik — do you want me to attach the worksheet to the external email or wait until after the call?

-Tessa
Senior Pricing Manager

Karthik — thanks for the detailed notes and to your team for the worksheet. The commercial approach looks reasonable and we prefer the amortized credit over 12 months (helps our Opex planning). Two quick clarifications:

1) For on-prem FIPS HSM: can you confirm the SOW day-rate and whether that will be fully covered by the implementation credit or only partially?
2) Audit log predictable SKU: would we be able to cap monthly spend if we choose the $3/user/mo option? We need a hard cap for internal approvals.

If you can confirm those two items I can route this to Legal and Procurement. We are aiming to finalize commercial terms by 12/10.

Best,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — quick follow-up after internal alignment. Answers below and next steps attached.

1) On‑prem FIPS HSM SOW day-rate: standard professional services day-rate is $2,400/day. Typical FIPS key‑ceremony and network integration runs 8–12 person-days; we will cover up to 100% of that cost via the implementation credit in the Scale and Enterprise bands. For Pilot band we cover 60% and invoice remainder. We will include explicit MSA milestone language stating credit triggers.

2) Audit log cap: yes — we can include a hard monthly cap if you pick the Predictable SKU. Example: $3/user/mo for 90d retention with a $15k/month cap (can be dialed to your budget). Any overage beyond the cap will require signed approval.

Attached: commercial-summary-MedNova.pdf (one pager) and updated DocuSign envelope. Please confirm preferred commit band (Pilot / Scale / Enterprise) and whether you want 12-month amortization.

If you confirm, I will issue the DocuSign for exec signatures and route to Legal for the MSA addendum describing credit triggers.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Karthik

Redwood Inference
